indicators.name: 10-Year Treasury Yield
indicators.whyWeWatchIt: The 10-year Treasury yield affects stock valuations, bond attractiveness, mortgage rates, and discount-rate discussions.

thresholds.red: Above 5% or up at least 1 percentage point in three months

indicators.alertMessage: 10-year yield is elevated but not in the red zone at 4.71%.

indicators.name: Yield Curve
indicators.whyWeWatchIt: The 10-year minus 2-year Treasury spread is a common recession and cycle-risk indicator.
indicators.alertMessage: Yield curve is flat at 0.46 percentage points.

indicators.name: Credit Spreads
indicators.whyWeWatchIt: Credit spreads help show whether corporate bond markets are calm or signaling financial stress.
indicators.alertMessage: Credit spreads are normal at 1.68 percentage points.

indicators.name: Unemployment Rate
indicators.whyWeWatchIt: The unemployment rate helps the family discuss labor-market strength and possible recession risk.

thresholds.green: Stable, up 0.2 percentage points or less over three months
thresholds.yellow: Up 0.2 to 0.5 percentage points over three months
thresholds.red: Up more than 0.5 percentage points over three months

indicators.name: VIX
indicators.whyWeWatchIt: VIX helps frame whether market fear is creating opportunity or whether calm conditions may signal complacency.

indicators.name: Dollar Index Proxy
indicators.whyWeWatchIt: A stronger dollar can affect commodities, international earnings, and global financial conditions.

thresholds.green: Stable or falling over three months
thresholds.red: Rising more than 5% over three months

indicators.alertMessage: Dollar proxy is moderately firm at 118.9.

indicators.name: Gold/Oil Ratio
indicators.source: Manual until reliable public source is approved
indicators.whyWeWatchIt: The gold/oil ratio can help discuss inflation, commodity stress, and relative real-asset pricing.

indicators.name: Gold/Silver Ratio
indicators.source: Manual until reliable public source is approved
indicators.whyWeWatchIt: The gold/silver ratio can help discuss precious-metal sentiment and economic-cycle expectations.
